content: WebAudio autoplay (MDN autoplay guide): browsers block AudioContext playback until sticky user activation; context starts 'suspended'; start()/resume() outside a gesture fails silently or throws NotAllowedError. Mitigation: create ctx lazily and call ctx.resume() inside the first pointerdown/keydown handler — the game already has press()/release() gesture hooks. No 'autoplay policy changed' event exists; poll ctx.state or resume opportunistically per input.
